description: This file declares the interface for reflog walk operations, including functions for initializing, releasing, adding entries, displaying messages, and retrieving metadata related to reflog entries in a version control system.

methods.name: init_reflog_walk
methods.description: Initializes a reflog walk info structure.

methods.name: reflog_walk_info_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with reflog walk info.

methods.name: add_reflog_for_walk
methods.description: Adds a reflog entry for a specific commit and name during walk.

methods.name: show_reflog_message
methods.description: Displays a reflog message based on walk info and display options.

methods.name: get_reflog_message
methods.description: Retrieves reflog message into a string buffer.

methods.name: get_reflog_ident
methods.description: Retrieves the identifier of the reflog entry.

methods.name: get_reflog_timestamp
methods.description: Gets the timestamp associated with a reflog entry.

methods.name: get_reflog_selector
methods.description: Generates a selector string for reflog entries based on date and other options.

methods.name: reflog_walk_empty
methods.description: Checks if reflog walk is empty.

methods.name: next_reflog_entry
methods.description: Advances to the next reflog entry in the walk.
